Patient P-D004 (51, M, Spanish-speaking, home tract 17031610300) has commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit. Takes losartan 25 mg daily (tier 1, $10/month copay, no refill gap). Most recent screener (2026-10-19) flags transportation need ("no") and no food/housing/utilities concerns. Today's primary-care visit (V-D004, appt:1 at 16:00) was kept. Med cost burden is low ($10/mo) but copay-assistance options are listed; transport options are limited by age (51) and commercial coverage.

Med_cost eligibility: Clinic Rx Fund (short-term copay help for current patients) — patient is a current patient, likely eligible. Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer programs) — Extra Help is generally Medicare/Medicaid, so less likely for this commercial patient; manufacturer programs may still apply. Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund is a referral-tracking link with no stated eligibility.

Transport eligibility: Senior Shuttle West (adults 60+) — patient is 51, NOT eligible. Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid members) — patient has commercial coverage, NOT eligible. Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification, decisions up to 21 days) — only if a qualifying disability exists and lead time allows.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Contact the clinic about short-term copay assistance for current patients; ask Dr. Castillo's office or the pharmacy for the application.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Ask the pharmacy for help applying to Extra Help and manufacturer patient-assistance programs; note Extra Help is generally for Medicare/Medicaid, so confirm fit for commercial coverage.

options.name: Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund
options.how_to_access: Use the referral-tracking link to document the referral; eligibility not stated.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Call to apply for ADA paratransit certification; decisions can take up to 21 days, so start early if ongoing rides are needed.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides 7 AM–5 PM, but limited to adults 60+ to medical appointments; patient is 51 so not eligible.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only; call at least 2 business days ahead. Patient has commercial insurance, so not eligible.
